# Vendored tools

## `rareunzip.py`

Standalone Rare RZIP raw-deflate decompressor imported from
[`n64decomp/banjo-kazooie`](https://github.com/n64decomp/banjo-kazooie) commit
`9db90a003fff15d13d29505d571aff2543b50383`,
`tools/rareunzip.py`.

The upstream project is licensed under CC0 1.0 Universal. This tool is kept
separate from game-specific source and configuration.
